preservation: 2号 許容限界 remains batas kritis; 是正処置 remains tindakan korektif
No change to options order, hashes, flags, numbers or canonical Japanese
Identical explanation and correct-option reason receive identical transformations
limitations: Terminology audit by AI, not native-speaker or food-domain certification
2024 edition not used to replace 2026 facts or allergen lists
2号 terms absent from the 1号 textbook (QC, productivity, foreman, traceability) retained unless supported by shared terminology
General prose hygiene/kebersihan retained when it does not denote the specific 食品衛生 or 一般衛生管理 term
5S explanatory verbs retained; source itself varies between index sanitasi and body Rawat for Seiketsu
Source uses sterilisasi broadly for 殺菌; did not mechanically replace context-sensitive microbe-reduction descriptions with claims of absolute sterility

termFamilyReview.finding: Index explicitly equates Shokuhin eisei with Keamanan pangan; canonical consumer illness/injury safety sense retained. General cleanliness prose is not blanket-replaced.
Body heading and definition explicitly use this exact term for common food hygiene controls; not generic public security.
Index explicitly maps Gahou to Endospora. Bacterial resistant forms are the intended sense; not fungal spores.
Exact indexed term; changes stay with level-1 contexts/shared diagrams. Level-2 許容限界 and OL/CL distinction retained.
Exact indexed term and HACCP principle5 PDF43. food-2-013 title and p3 heading Japanese explicitly 改善措置, so level-2 use here is justified; 是正処置 root-cause term not replaced.
Exact indexed hazard-factor label; diagram physical/chemical/biological grouping retained.
